content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Stock photos

This is not a plugin or a SaaS tool. It’s a complete commerce stack you own. Stripe and PayPal exclude countries like Nigeria because of perceived financial risk, regulatory hurdles, or currency instability. These platforms are centralized—they control the infrastructure. When they reject you, you’re locked out. Sovereign commerce infrastructure decentralizes this. It uses open-source tools and on-chain payments. You host your stock photos on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare R2. Orders are processed via Cloudflare Workers. Payments are verified on-chain through NOWPayments. No single entity controls any part of the process. This is structural independence. It’s built for creators who cannot rely on global payment processors. It’s not a temporary fix. It’s permanent infrastructure.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Here’s the stack: GitHub Pages hosts your storefront. It’s free and globally distributed. Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic—processing orders, verifying payments, and triggering file delivery. Supabase stores order data securely. NOWPayments verifies crypto payments on-chain. When a buyer pays, NOWPayments sends a webhook to Cloudflare Workers. The worker confirms the payment, logs the order in Supabase, and delivers the stock photo via a secure link. No manual intervention. No platform fees except NOWPayments’ 0.5%. The entire process runs on infrastructure you own. GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Workers are free. Supabase’s free tier handles thousands of orders. This architecture is lightweight, fast, and immutable. It’s designed to operate without Stripe, PayPal, or any centralized payment processor.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is for digital creators in regions where Stripe and PayPal are unavailable or unreliable. If you sell stock photos, ebooks, or templates, this stack gives you global reach. It’s for creators who want ownership, not rental. With the Edge Commerce Stack, you’re not dependent on any platform. You’re not subject to their terms, fees, or country restrictions. This is for creators who understand infrastructure as a strategic asset. It’s for those who want to sell without asking permission. It’s pressure-tested in environments like Zimbabwe—where currency collapse and financial isolation are realities. If it works there, it works anywhere. This isn’t a solution for the edge case. It’s a new baseline for digital commerce.
Stripe and PayPal restrictions are structural. Sovereign infrastructure is the permanent solution.
The Components That Make It Work Together

GitHub Pages hosts your storefront. It’s static, fast, and free. Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic. They’re serverless, globally distributed, and free up to a million requests per month. Supabase provides a PostgreSQL database for order storage. Its free tier is sufficient for most creators. NOWPayments handles crypto payments. It supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, charges 0.5%, and requires no KYC. Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive delivers files securely. Each component is independent but integrates seamlessly. You configure NOWPayments to send webhooks to Cloudflare Workers. The worker verifies payments, logs orders in Supabase, and generates secure download links. This modularity means you can replace any component without disrupting the system. It’s infrastructure, not a platform.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by purchasing the Edge Commerce Stack ($197). It includes deployment within 48 hours, five products loaded, and end-to-end testing. If you prefer to build it yourself, the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) provides full documentation and source code. Either way, you own the stack after deployment. No ongoing fees. No subscriptions. To deploy, you’ll need a domain (optional but recommended). Set up NOWPayments and configure the webhook URL. Upload your stock photos to Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive. Test the entire flow before going live. This isn’t a one-click solution. It’s deliberate infrastructure. But once deployed, it’s yours. No one can shut it down. No one can block your access. This is how you sell stock photos without Stripe or PayPal—permanently.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Purchase the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) or the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) for self-deployment. 2. Set up a NOWPayments account and configure the webhook URL. 3. Upload your stock photos to Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive. 4. Test the payment flow using a test cryptocurrency transaction. 5. Deploy your storefront to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 6. Configure Cloudflare Workers to handle order processing and file delivery. 7. Set up Supabase to store order data securely. 8. Test the entire system end-to-end before going live. 9. Monitor transactions via Supabase and NOWPayments dashboards. 10. Scale by adding more products or integrating additional stacks.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not a developer?

Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes deployment within 48 hours. If you prefer to build it yourself, the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) provides full documentation and source code. No coding required for basic deployment.
What cryptocurrencies does NOWPayments support?

NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Binance Coin, and stablecoins like USDT. Recommended networks for low fees are BSC, Solana, and TRON—under $0.10 per transaction.
Do I need a domain to use this stack?
A domain is optional but recommended for professionalism. You can use GitHub Pages’ default URL or a custom domain. Cloudflare Pages also supports custom domains.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
NOWPayments is a payment processor, not a platform you depend on. If it fails, you can replace it with another crypto payment gateway without disrupting your stack. The architecture is modular.
Can I sell products other than stock photos?
Yes. The stack is designed for digital products like ebooks, templates, fonts, and software. Any file type can be delivered securely via Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive.
